platform.title: AI & Models
platform.description: Platform-wide control of AI providers, models, routing and policy. Only platform owners see this.

overview.systemFallback: When no configured model fits, Saqina uses the server's environment model if one is set, otherwise project rules.
overview.encryptionMissing: SAQINA_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set: credentials cannot be stored until it is configured on the server.

providers.title: Providers
providers.empty: No providers yet. Add one to use real models.
providers.name: Name
providers.baseUrlHint: Required for custom and compatible providers. https only (localhost allowed in development).
providers.secretHint: Write-only. Stored encrypted; never shown again. Leave empty to keep the current key.
providers.disconnectBody: The stored API key is revoked. Models stay registered but cannot answer until a new key is added.
providers.cliLogin: Signs in with the CLI's own login on the server

models.title: Models
models.empty: No models registered. Add the model ids your providers offer.
models.capabilitiesHint: Declare what this model supports. “Structured output” is needed for AI review, note analysis and reading documents. Models fetched from a provider get a best guess you can correct here.

fetch.title: Fetch models from a provider
fetch.hint: Lists the chat models your key can use. Pick the ones to add; you can change their abilities afterwards with Edit.
fetch.none: This provider did not list any chat models. Add one by hand with its model id.

errors.auth_failed: The provider refused the key. Check it on the Providers tab.
errors.network: Could not reach the provider. Check the address and try again.
errors.rate_limited: The provider is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.no_credential: This provider has no key yet. Add one on the Providers tab.
errors.bad_response: The provider answered in a format we do not recognise.
errors.unknown: Could not fetch the models. Try again.

models.defaultUnusable: “{model}” is chosen here but cannot be used right now: the model or its provider is disabled, or the provider connection failed its test. Test the provider on the Providers tab.

mapping.title: Agent model mapping
mapping.description: Which model each Saqina agent role uses. Project overrides apply only when policy allows them.

policies.title: Model policy
policies.allowProjectOverride: Projects may choose their own model
policies.allowAgentOverride: Agent mappings may override the default
policies.ownersHint: Owners manage AI providers, models and policy for every project on this installation.
policies.lastOwner: The last owner cannot be removed.
policies.envBootstrap: No owner is stored yet; PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAILS grants owner access until one is.

errors.encryptionUnavailable: The server has no encryption key configured.
errors.local: Local endpoints are not allowed here.
errors.private: Private network addresses are not allowed.
errors.capability: The selected model does not support the required capabilities
errors.accountEmailMismatch: The email does not match your account.
errors.accountBlockedLastPlatformOwner: You are the only platform owner. Hand the role over first.
errors.accountBlockedOwnsSharedProjects: You still own projects other people use.
errors.accountBlockedOwnsSharedOrganizations: You still own an organization with other members.

whiteLabel.locked: White label is locked for this organization.
whiteLabel.pastEnd: The end date is already in the past.

errors.tooLarge: The skill is too large (50 KB at most).
errors.frontmatter: The SKILL.md needs a front matter block with a name (lowercase, dashes) and a description.
errors.empty: The skill has no instructions after the front matter.
errors.notSkill: Link to a SKILL.md file or the folder that holds one.
errors.unreachable: The file could not be downloaded. Check the link and that the repository is public.
errors.builtin: Built-in skills can be switched off but not removed.
errors.urlKey: Put '{apiKey}' in the URL where the key goes.
errors.notLocal: Use a localhost address for a local server.
errors.taken: That key is already in use.
errors.cliOff: Local CLIs are switched off. Turn them on above first.
errors.cliNotInstalled: That CLI is not installed on this server.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Skills are working methods (SKILL.md) every project uses. Saqina reads only the text; nothing in a skill is run. Superpowers and antislop ship built in; antislop always runs while writing (DURING mode).
skills.empty: No skills yet. Install one from GitHub or paste a SKILL.md.
skills.removeBody: Projects stop using this skill from the next run. Install it again to bring it back.
skills.urlHint: A SKILL.md file, or the folder that holds it. Public repositories only.
skills.contentHint: Starts with a --- block holding name and description, then the instructions.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.hint: MCP servers connected once for every project. Agents may read through tools marked low risk; anything else waits for approval in the project.
connectors.customHint: Any MCP server over streamable HTTP.

presets.firecrawl: Scrape and crawl web pages into clean text for references.
presets.exa: Web search tuned for code and documentation.

connectors.empty: Nothing connected yet. Add a preset or a custom server above.
connectors.removeBody: The key is deleted and every project loses this server's tools.

result.ok: Connected. {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} found.

connectors.name: Name
connectors.endpointHint: https only. For a key in the URL, write '{apiKey}' where it goes.
connectors.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
connectors.secretOptional: Optional. Without a key the server answers with lower limits.

agents.title: Agent registry
agents.description: Who each agent is and what it may do. Projects follow these definitions; they cannot change them. A change applies to new executions, never to one that is running.
agents.archiveBody: An archived agent takes no new tasks and leaves every project's team. Past executions keep their record.
agents.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It cannot change later.
agents.name: Name
agents.instructionsHint: What this agent is told before every task. Write the job, the limits and how to finish.
agents.modelDefault: Use the role's model from Agent mapping
agents.toolsHint: Only these tools can run for this agent. Merging and deploying are never available.
agents.permissionsHint: What the agent may touch in a project.
agents.skillsHint: Pick installed skills this agent applies on every task. Built-in skills ship with Saqina; custom skills are the ones you installed.

cli.title: Local CLI
cli.intro: Use a CLI that is already logged in on the machine that serves Saqina, such as Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode, instead of an API key. Saqina only starts these programs, in an empty temporary folder, with no tools and none of its own secrets. Only platform owners see this.
cli.login: Log in on the server with
cli.testOk: The CLI answered. It is now in the provider list below and can be set as a model.
cli.testFailed: The CLI did not answer. Check that it is logged in on the server, then test again.
cli.rescan: Reload this page after installing or logging in to a CLI to see the change.
cli.switchHint: Off by default. While it is off, no CLI is started and any connected CLI stops answering. Turning it on lets Saqina run the CLIs below on this server, as the user that runs Saqina.
cli.detectOff: Not checked while local CLIs are off

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Repository, MCP servers and external agents for this project. Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again.

repository.title: Repository
repository.tokenHint: Write-only. Use a token limited to this repository.
repository.prefixHint: Agents only write to branches starting with this. The default branch is never written.
repository.disconnectBody: The stored token is revoked. Branches and commits already made stay in the repository.
repository.head: Head

docSync.title: Document sync
docSync.intro: PRD, PLAN and custom documents are kept in sync with the docs folder of the repository. Changes from Saqina go to the branch saqina/docs-sync as one pull request, and nothing is written to the main branch. Business documents never sync.
docSync.unsupported: Document sync supports GitHub repositories only.
docSync.folderHint: Folder in the repository, relative to its root.
docSync.folderInvalid: This folder name is not valid. Use a relative path such as docs or documentation/product.
docSync.pending: {count, plural, one {# document waiting in the pull request} other {# documents waiting in the pull request}}
docSync.conflicts: {count, plural, one {# document has a conflict} other {# documents have a conflict}}

errors.rate_limited: GitHub is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.auth_failed: GitHub rejected the access token. Reconnect the repository with a valid token.
errors.not_found: Repository or branch not found. Check the repository connection.
errors.too_large: A document is too large to sync.
errors.network: Could not reach GitHub. Try again shortly.
errors.provider_error: GitHub returned an error. Try again later.

skipped.busy: Another sync is already running. Try again in a moment.
skipped.unsupported: This repository host cannot sync documents.
skipped.clean: Everything is already up to date.

docSync.summary: Sync finished: {pushed} sent, {pulled} received, {created} created, {conflicts} conflicts.
docSync.webhookIntro: Add this webhook so changes pushed to the repository reach Saqina.
docSync.secretWarning: Copy this secret now. It cannot be shown again.

steps.open: In the repository on GitHub, open Settings > Webhooks > Add webhook.
steps.url: Payload URL: paste the URL above.
steps.events: Which events: Just the push event.

docSync.secretMissing: The secret was shown when sync was turned on. If you lost it, create a new one and update the GitHub webhook.
docSync.rotateBody: The current secret stops working. Update the secret in the GitHub webhook, or pushes will no longer reach Saqina.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.name: Name
mcp.disconnectBody: Its tools are switched off and the token is revoked.
mcp.discoveredHint: New tools start as discovered and do nothing until enabled.

result.failed: MCP connection unavailable: {reason}. No tools were run.

mcp.platformHint: Added by the platform owner for every project. You can still switch its tools on or off here.

agents.title: External agents
agents.description: Agents outside Saqina. Handoff works for every agent: Saqina builds a context package you hand over and paste the result back. Webhook agents receive it directly.
agents.secretHint: At least 16 characters. Used to sign requests and verify callbacks.
agents.exportOnly: Handoff agents need no connection test.

handoff.title: Hand off to {agent}
handoff.redactions: {count, plural, =0 {No secrets found} one {# file had a secret removed} other {# files had secrets removed}}
handoff.stale: The project has changed since this handoff (now v{current}). The agent may be working from older context.

placeholders.instructions: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page

handoff.pasteHint: JSON in the requested format, or plain text (stored as the summary).
handoff.notReal: Saqina did not run this agent. It prepared the package; the result below is what the agent reported.

ai.title: AI configuration
ai.description: Which model answers in this project. The platform policy decides what may be changed here.
ai.notAllowed: The platform owner does not allow project-level model choices.

stack.title: Tech stack
stack.description: What the project is built with. Shared with agents in every context package.
stack.mismatch: {key}: the project says {project}, the repository uses {repository}.
